description: Call this for historical mNAV of one treasury ticker (MSTR, XXI, MPJPY, or ASST), not the live scoreboard (use get_treasuries for that). Returns daily mNAV, price, and BTC holdings, oldest first. The days argument snaps to 30, 90, 180 or 365 (default 90). Educational market data, not investment advice.

days.description: Lookback window in days · snapped to the nearest supported window (30, 90, 180, 365); defaults to 90

name: get_treasury_history
